title: Find the right fit. Open fewer boxes.
subtitle: Explore the collection, choose exact variants, and bring only the favourites to the counter.
searchPlaceholder: Try “black cotton full sleeve collar tshirt XL”
similarNote: These do not meet every search term. Check the differences before choosing.
emptyBody: Try removing a filter or changing your search. Alternatives below are clearly separated.
sessionNeeded: Start a customer session to shortlist this item.
added: Added to the active customer shortlist. Stock is unchanged.
representative: Illustrative placeholder — selected colour is not photographed.
notReserved: Shortlisting does not reserve or deduct stock.
required: Enter a whole quantity between 1 and 100,000.
compareNote: Compare the exact colour/size shown on each selected card. Open details to choose a different variant or shortlist. Up to three items.
galleryNote: Uploaded photo angles or labelled illustrations. Swipe between available frames in the gallery; this is not a 3D model.
styleStudio: Open Style Studio · angles, colours and try-on
offerError: Offer data is unavailable. Standard prices are shown; ask staff to restore valid offer data.
offerBilling: Ask staff to apply the active offer in Billing before payment.
